avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inducer reduces esomeprazole levels and effectiveness
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult provider before initiating or discontinuing St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium (high-dose supplementation)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: PPIs reduce gastric acid required for calcium absorption; chronic use increases deficiency risk
avoid_supplements.action: Take calcium supplements at least 2 hours after esomeprazole; consider citrate form for better absorption

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Elevated gastric pH from PPI impairs iron absorption; separate dosing times
avoid_supplements.action: Administer iron at least 2-4 hours apart from esomeprazole; monitor hemoglobin if long-term PPI use

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Long-term PPI use may increase hypomagnesemia risk; supplementation may be beneficial
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum magnesium with chronic use; supplement if levels decline

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B12 supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Chronic PPI use reduces B12 absorption; supplementation may prevent deficiency
caution_supplements.action: Consider B12 monitoring in patients on long-term esomeprazole therapy

caution_supplements.name: Clopidogrel
caution_supplements.mechanism: Esomeprazole is a potent CYP2C19 inhibitor that may reduce clopidogrel activation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced antiplatelet effect; alternative PPI or H2-blocker may be considered

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays esomeprazole absorption and reduces peak plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Administer esomeprazole on an empty stomach, 30-60 minutes before breakfast

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase gastric acid secretion partially offsetting PPI effect
caution_foods.action: Limit excessive caffeine intake; not a strict contraindication

caution_foods.name: Spicy or acidic foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May irritate gastric mucosa despite PPI therapy in sensitive individuals
caution_foods.action: Patients should assess individual tolerance; no universal restriction required

monitoring_notes: Monitor for long-term complications of PPI use including hypomagnesemia, B12 deficiency, and calcium malabsorption with chronic therapy (>1 year). CYP2C19 polymorphisms significantly affect esomeprazole metabolism; poor metabolizers may require dose adjustment.
